title: The Params feature: from core to an add-on
description: How the Params tab and extension is recorded in the zaproxy and zap-extensions histories: introduced in core in 2011 and migrated to the params add-on from 2025.
narrative:
Many ZAP users rely on the Params tab without thinking about where it came from. The Parameters tab was added to core in October 2011, in a commit that brought in database classes such as RecordParam and TableParam. In 2018 params commits in core added multipart form POST parameters to the tab and let a parameter name be added or removed as an anti-CSRF token.

In November 2025 zap-extensions began a params add-on, and the earliest commit touching it is Params Initial Relocation. Moving the tab's code into an add-on probably lets it be updated without waiting for a core release.

In May 2026 a core commit deprecated and unhooked the params extension, adding deprecation annotations to classes such as ExtensionParams and ParamsPanel. In June 2026 zap-extensions updated add-ons to use the params add-on. The most recent entry cited, from June 2026, has add-ons using the params add-on, while core marks its own extension as deprecated.

chapters.title: The Parameters tab is added, 2011
chapters.text: The commit "Added Parameters tab" is dated 2011-10-29 in zaproxy. It adds database classes such as RecordParam and TableParam and changes Messages.properties and Control.java.

chapters.title: Enhancements in 2018
chapters.text: Commits to the params extension in zaproxy include "Fix Issue 4391 - Include MultipartFormPost Params on Params Tab" (2018-02-13) and "Params Tab - Add/Remove Param Name as Anti-CSRF Token for Any Param" (2018-06-05).

chapters.title: The params add-on begins, 2025
chapters.text: In zap-extensions the earliest commit touching addOns/params is "Params Initial Relocation", dated 2025-11-11.

chapters.title: Core params extension deprecated, 2026
chapters.text: On 2026-05-15 zaproxy has "Deprecate and unhook params extension"; its diff adds @Deprecated annotations (19 added lines match) to classes such as ExtensionParams, ParamsPanel, and database classes for params. On 2026-06-01 zap-extensions has "Update add-ons to use params add-on (#7385)".
